actors.note: The coordinator currently posts with the maintainer's own account, so GitHub actor identity alone cannot tell them apart. Coordinator events are authenticated by the local run ledger (comment id + event digest); maintainer decisions are comments by a maintainer login that are absent from the ledger. A dedicated bot account removes this ambiguity; see docs/development/github-adapter.md.
